did.description: The DID of the person who registered the book. Included here, so it's verifiable with the bookSig.

book.description: The book that was dropped (a org.passingreads.book.registration)

bookPub.description: The multicodec public key of the book.

bookSig.description: The signature of this record, without this attribute, as created by the private key associated with the book

location.description: Where this event occurred (an h3 cell, an OSM place, or a link to an outpost — org.passingreads.outpost.registration)

occurredAt.description: Client-declared timestamp of when the book was dropped

main.description: The status of a book has changed.

name.description: The name of the place from OpenStreetMap.

osmId.description: The OpenStreetMap element ID in interoperable format: N (node), W (way), or R (relation) prefix followed by numeric ID. Example: N123456789

value.description: The H3 cell index for proximity queries.

category.description: The type of place (e.g., cafe, library, park).
